latestVersion.changelog:
Video Maker 4K — Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered tool for creating and exporting professional 4K videos from raw footage.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV formats.
- Simplifies editing with natural language instructions: cut highlights, add background music, and export in 4K.
- Automated cloud-based GPU processing delivers 4K MP4 videos within minutes.
- Includes seamless session handling, credit system, and robust error management.
- No complex software required; optimized for content creators and filmmakers seeking fast, high-quality results.
